method.daily_bar_rule: A UTC daily bar is complete only when all 24 hourly rows and all 24 quote_volume values are present. No bars are synthesized.
method.history_rule: Require 365 consecutive complete UTC daily bars ending at the last fully completed daily bar before the rebalance.
method.eligibility_rule: Require a Binance USDT-margined perpetual with a crypto-native base asset. Exclude BTC, ETH, fiat/cash-pegged assets, and index or non-crypto-underlying products. Apply product classification from dated venue or issuer evidence before any performance run.
method.point_in_time_rule: Only data through the decision timestamp contributes to an instrument's availability and trailing-liquidity eligibility. Future bars and returns are not used to qualify an earlier date.
method.liquidity_rule: At each rebalance, rank available eligible contracts by trailing 30-day USDT quote volume; the audit checks that at least 100 contracts can qualify, but does not calculate the ranking or any performance outcome.

development_start.decision: Earliest Monday with at least 100 eligible crypto-native USDT perpetuals, each with 365 complete prior UTC daily bars and complete quote-volume observations. Top-100 liquidity selection is therefore possible from this date.

limitations: The archive manifest does not contain a complete dated product-classification or official onboard/delist table. Freeze a documented classification registry before performance calculations.
The audit did not calculate returns, signals, candidate portfolio weights, Sharpe ratios, or other strategy metrics.
The historical holdout is not fully available in the archived source. Do not open it until the missing interval is archived and coverage is verified.
The fixed cost assumption is not size-scaled and does not establish trading capacity.
